description:
Closes Phase 1.4.

- sigil_F passes subengine: Filament.VNodeEngine to TagEngine.compile (or it's the default).
- VNodeCompiler.compile pipeline runs only the vnode-AST passes.
- Remove Renderer.unwrap_for_embedding's :rendered_struct shim.
- Remove Filament.Web.to_iodata's {:rendered_struct, %Rendered{}} clause.
- Remove TagEngine.wrap_rendered (and the component/component_keyed direct invocation path that returned Rendered).
- Update tests to drop {:rendered_struct, ...} wrappers wherever they were added in Phase 1.2.

## Acceptance
- mix test green (full suite).
- mix compile --warnings-as-errors green.
- grep -n '%Phoenix\.LiveView\.Rendered{}' in lib/filament/ shows only LiveView adapter code (no compiler-emitted construction).
- ~F evaluates to a vnode tree (or a closure returning one).
title: Phase 1.4.7: Switch sigil_F to VNodeEngine; remove transitional shims
